description:
Pricing on both rails. Standard: 0.1 XRP or 0.05 USDC. AI-enhanced: 0.5 XRP or 0.25 USDC. FREE.

    Each tier is reported as drops/xrp (XRPL) and usdc/usdc_micro (Solana).
    The legacy "tourism" key is retained as a deprecated alias for "standard"
    (both resolve to the standard tier: 100000 drops / 0.1 XRP, or 0.05 USDC)
    for backward compatibility. Prefer "standard". Will be removed in MCP API v2.
name: xrplme_get_pricing
